targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', e.event_time) AS time, m.region, SUM(e.energy_kwh) FROM energy_readings e JOIN meters m USING (meter_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_time) GROUP BY 1, m.region ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_time) AS time, SUM(energy_kwh) AS kwh FROM energy_readings WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w(s) AS (VALUES ('2026-09-01'::date),('2026-09-08'::date),('2026-09-15'::date),('2026-09-22'::date)) SELECT to_char(w.s,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week_start, SUM(e.energy_kwh) AS kwh FROM w LEFT JOIN energy_readings e ON e.event_time >= w.s::timestamptz AND e.event_time < (w.s+7)::timestamptz GROUP BY w.s ORDER BY w.s
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_time) AS time, SUM(energy_kwh) FROM energy_readings WHERE meter_id = 1000000000 AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH rc AS (SELECT m.region, COUNT(DISTINCT m.meter_id) AS meters FROM meters m GROUP BY m.region), days AS (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))/86400 AS n), obs AS (SELECT m.region, COUNT(DISTINCT (e.meter_id, e.event_time)) AS n FROM energy_readings e JOIN meters m USING (meter_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_time) GROUP BY m.region) SELECT rc.region, 100.0 * obs.n / (rc.meters * (SELECT n FROM days) * 96) AS pct FROM rc JOIN obs USING (region) ORDER BY rc.region
